_comment: Golden table for the made-up example network profile: priority markers, ignored capcodes and redaction. OWNED BY THE PROJECT OWNER. 'stored_text' null means the page is dropped. Text is shown after control-token removal and redaction.

cases.name: phone number redacted, job number survives
cases.raw: POCSAG512: Address:  100001  Function: 0  Alpha:   QDCheck the shed Saturday. Text 0412 345 678 if available. EX0000001

expect.stored_text: QDCheck the shed Saturday. Text REDACTED if available. EX0000001

cases.name: phone number without spaces redacted
cases.raw: POCSAG512: Address:  100001  Function: 0  Alpha:   QDCall 0412345678 to confirm

cases.name: age and sex redacted, condition and address kept
cases.raw: POCSAG512: Address:  100001  Function: 0  Alpha:   @@EX0000005 MED1 PERSON COLLAPSED AGE: 52 SEX: M @ 1 EXAMPLE ST, MADEUPTON #STN1

expect.stored_text: @@EX0000005 MED1 PERSON COLLAPSED REDACTED REDACTED @ 1 EXAMPLE ST, MADEUPTON #STN1

cases.name: control tokens removed
cases.raw: POCSAG512: Address:  100001  Function: 0  Alpha:   QDHall unlocked from 6pm<NUL><NUL>

cases.name: heartbeat capcode kept
cases.raw: POCSAG512: Address:     50  Function: 0  Alpha:   QDNetwork heartbeat 000123

cases.name: unknown marker gives null priority
cases.raw: POCSAG512: Address:  100001  Function: 0  Alpha:   Plain text with no marker

cases.name: large-event code found (R87)
cases.raw: POCSAG512: Address:  100001  Function: 0  Alpha:   @@EX0000101 GRS3 DG0801 GRASS FIRE @ SAMPLE RD, MADEUPTON #STN1

expect.stored_text: @@EX0000101 GRS3 DG0801 GRASS FIRE @ SAMPLE RD, MADEUPTON #STN1

cases.name: two large-event codes, each once, in order (R87)
cases.raw: POCSAG512: Address:  100001  Function: 0  Alpha:   @@EX0000102 GRS3 DG0802 DG0803 DG0802 GRASS FIRE @ SAMPLE RD, MADEUPTON #STN1

expect.stored_text: @@EX0000102 GRS3 DG0802 DG0803 DG0802 GRASS FIRE @ SAMPLE RD, MADEUPTON #STN1

cases.name: not a large-event code: 5 digits, or letters run on (R87)
cases.raw: POCSAG512: Address:  100001  Function: 0  Alpha:   @@EX0000103 GRS3 DG08011 XDG0801 GRASS FIRE @ SAMPLE RD, MADEUPTON #STN1

expect.stored_text: @@EX0000103 GRS3 DG08011 XDG0801 GRASS FIRE @ SAMPLE RD, MADEUPTON #STN1
